title: First encoded shape predicate
statement: For Boolean lists $y,x,w$ and a natural number $s$, the first shape condition holds exactly when $y$ is the pair encoding of $x$ and the pair encoding of $w$ with the binary digit list of $s$, and the length of that digit list is at most the length of the binary digit list of $|y|$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean lists y, x, and w
